policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads. policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: open-ended; checkpoints/findings are never global completion; maintain nonempty frontier and exact next action until hard runtime/tool termination. While the sanitized Phase-1 overlay is active, leaf completion/block/low marginal value means select the next useful non-conflicting Phase-1 neuroscience/state-continuation leaf rather than resuming unrelated base work.
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts. Every Phase-1 receipt/checkpoint must explicitly bind phase_id/root_problem_id/assignment_task_id, the exact frozen DESIRED_STATE parsed control_revision plus Git blob SHA, this exact neuroscience config parsed config_revision plus Git blob SHA, and bootstrap_valid. Parse authority revisions only from those exact frozen control bodies. Any authority mismatch/unverifiable identity is diagnostic-only and cannot count as positive Phase-1 evidence.
policy.control_freshness: Obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. At H1 read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config at that exact SHA, parse and freeze both path/revision/blob identities, then repeat SHA-only ref lookup before substantive work and restart bootstrap only if a frozen authoritative identity changed. The first own-state/public-source semantic read freezes semantics. After freeze, unrelated generic main advancement alone is not a semantic stop; do not consume newer-head semantics. Exact authority identity may be revalidated using SHA/path/blob-only transport when required, and own role-local writes remain current-blob/CAS/readback guarded.

phase1_assignment_contract.activation_rule: When the exact frozen DESIRED_STATE says the Phase-1 clean overlay is active and assigns this task to neuroscience, this is the active assignment for the invocation. The substantive base neuroscience role, prior scientific findings/frontier, recovery semantics and exact base continuation remain preserved as restoration metadata, not as default active work during Phase 1.
phase1_assignment_contract.first_valid_run_requirement: After a fresh valid bootstrap, reconstruct the latest own clean LATEST/STATE, preserve its scientific/base continuation verbatim by reference, and BEFORE broad new research persist/read back a task-bound Phase-1 checkpoint or receipt proving the current phase/root/task and exact root/config provenance. Then run the smallest own-state/public-source acceptance probe that can falsify safe state reconstruction and recurrence-sensitive checkpoint continuation for this role.
phase1_assignment_contract.expected_output: A current phase/root/task-bound role-local artifact and immutable own receipt with bootstrap_valid=true, exact frozen root/config provenance, base_continuation_preserved=true, a concrete tested state-reconstruction/continuation mechanism or exact missing Chat capability, exact tested scope, and a nonempty Phase-1 frontier.
phase1_assignment_contract.base_state_reuse_rule: Existing CAUSE/PF-HMM, latent-cause, memory-control or other neuroscience findings may be reused only as own scientific evidence when directly relevant to the current Phase-1 mechanism test. Their existence alone is not Phase-1 acceptance proof and must not substitute for the current task-bound checkpoint/receipt.
phase1_assignment_contract.completion_block_rule: If the current subleaf completes, is Chat-infeasible, becomes blocked or loses marginal value, checkpoint the concrete result/blocker and immediately continue with the next highest-value non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf inside the clean neuroscience/state-reconstruction domain. Do not restore unrelated base research as active work while Phase 1 remains active.
